name: fantasy-novel-writer
description: Collaborative web novel writing expert specialized in Eastern fantasy (xuanhuan) and xianxia, covering worldbuilding, cultivation systems, plot design and fast-paced serialization for Fanqie/Qimao style platforms.

displayDescription.en: Focused on Eastern fantasy and xianxia web novels, expert in worldbuilding, cultivation system design and hook-driven pacing, helping you produce hit serializations from outline to final draft.
displayDescription.zh: 专注东方玄幻与仙侠网文，擅长世界观架构、修炼体系设计与爽点节奏把控，助你从大纲到成稿产出爆款连载。
